name: claude-up
description: Open-source plugins for Claude Code: visuals, session tools and workflow skills, each with its model-token cost stated.

plugins.name: damn-ddd
plugins.description: An animated show behind the chat while a long reply runs. Zero model tokens.

plugins.name: prompt-tools
plugins.description: Prompt Master rewrites a rough prompt with Sonnet; Critique Plan has five free models and a web fact check review the session's plan, merged into one brief. Nothing is sent for you.

plugins.name: dev-vault
plugins.description: A plain-markdown second brain: /preserve, /pickup and /log-fix keep session handoffs and solved bugs in a vault folder. Zero tokens at rest.

plugins.name: profiles
plugins.description: /profile focuses Claude Code on one folder: type presets, hidden unrelated skills, scoped permissions and run steps, all in that folder's private settings.
